build_postman_package: run python3 setup.py build develop to build and install the postman package with C++ extensions
install_postman_with_pip: run pip install . -vv to install the postman package and its torch dependency
review_build_ext_class: review the custom build_ext class that runs make develop before building setuptools extensions
refactor_build_ext_class: refactor the build_ext class to change the make develop subprocess command or working directory
summarize_setup_config: summarize the setuptools configuration for the postman package including name version and dependencies
